title: Loopback API contract
description: The local HTTP API's contract (F1c B5, design D6 incl. DG-4): its endpoints with their scope, the loopback host names and origins it accepts, and the names of its token, CSRF and owner-proof headers. bin/loopback_guard.py judges every request against it (STL-OWN-850..858); a new endpoint is a new row, no code change. Owner-only: only the owner path writes it.

port_source.description: Where the port in Host and in an origin's {port} comes from: bound = the port the server is bound to (the guard's session.port); no port is fixed in data or code.

hosts.description: The host names a request's Host header may carry, each followed by :<port> (an IPv6 address in brackets). Loopback names only: any other name (DNS rebinding) is refused, STL-OWN-850.

origins.description: The Origin values accepted: scheme://host[:port], {port} standing for the bound port. No wildcard and no null: an Origin not listed is refused on every request (STL-OWN-851); a state-changing request needs one of these (STL-OWN-852).

token_header.description: The header carrying the API token (every request, every scope; STL-OWN-854).

csrf_header.description: The header carrying the CSRF token (every state-changing request; STL-OWN-853).

proof_header.description: The header carrying an owner-write request's owner proof: the compact JSON of an owner_auth.py proof (object or list) over the action {op: http, target: "<METHOD> <path>", old_digest: 64 zeros, new_digest: sha256 of the raw body}.

owner_class.description: The owner-auth policy action class an owner-write proof must meet (owner_auth.require).

method.description: Matched exactly. GET, HEAD and OPTIONS are the only methods that are not state-changing.

path.description: Matched exactly (a trailing slash or a query string makes another, unknown path).

scope.description: read: the API token is enough; owner-write: the API token and an owner proof.
